definitions.explanation: A popular Japanese-style breaded and deep-fried shrimp dish. The shrimp is coated in flour, egg, and panko before frying, then served with tartar sauce or tonkatsu sauce.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{晩|ばん}ごはん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧エビフライだ。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|だい}{好物|こうぶつ}→大好物：16283_daikoubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧エビフライ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{３本|さんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: My child ate three of their favorite fried shrimp.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名古屋|なごや}→名古屋：19405_nagoya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧エビフライ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}くて→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Nagoya's fried shrimp are famous for being long and large.

notes:
Compound of エビ (shrimp) + ⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧ (fry, from English). A yōshoku (Japanese-Western) staple often served as part of a lunch set, in a bento, or with curry rice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エビフライ⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧: fried shrimp set meal
- エビフライ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧タルタル⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put tartar sauce on fried shrimp
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧エビフライ: homemade fried shrimp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura — lighter batter, uses different technique; not breaded
- エビカツ: shrimp cutlet — minced shrimp formed into a patty and breaded
- ⟦フライ→フライ：11124_furai⟧: fry (suffix) — generic for breaded deep-fried items, also used in アジフライ (fried horse mackerel), カキフライ (fried oysters)
